jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (BAD Product)
Product Manager (m/w/d) – Vermögensberatungsplattform apeiron
jobs.description:
Über Uns

Ginmon ist einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Deutschland. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2014 in Frankfurt am Main verfolgt das Unternehmen die Mission, professionelles, wissenschaftlich fundiertes Vermögensmanagement einer breiten Zielgruppe zugänglich zu machen. Mit apeiron hat Ginmon diese Technologie und Investment Expertise zu einer eigenständigen B2B-Plattform weiterentwickelt, die sich gezielt an unabhängige Vermögensberater:innen richtet. apeiron unterstützt Berater:innen mit intelligenten Tools für Beratung, Portfoliomanagement, digitales Onboarding, Gebührenabrechnung und Wertpapierabwicklung und ermöglicht ihnen damit ein modernes, skalierbares Endkundenerlebnis.

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) übernimmst du die Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung von apeiron und gestaltest somit die technologische Zukunft der unabhängigen Vermögensberatung in Deutschland aktiv mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Markt- und Nutzerforschung durch und identifizierst neue Produkt-Features und Trends im Bereich WealthTech.

  • Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools wie Claude, Gemini sowie Design-Software wie Figma, um Analysen, Nutzerflows, Produktideen und erste Prototypen schneller zu entwickeln.

  • Du entwickelst die Produkt Roadmap für apeiron und erarbeitest gemeinsam mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams detaillierte Produktanforderungen, User Stories und Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen im Unternehmen sowie mit externen Partnern und weiteren Interessengruppen zusammen und stimmst dich regelmäßig mit ihnen ab.

  • Du stehst im laufenden Austausch mit unabhängigen Vermögensberater:innen, holst kontinuierlich Feedback ein und übersetzt deren Anforderungen in konkrete Produktverbesserungen.

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Produktfunktionen spezifikationsgerecht, in hoher Qualität und termingerecht umgesetzt werden.

  • Du beobachtest die Leistung bestehender Funktionen und der zugrunde liegenden Plattform und identifizierst Potenziale für technische Optimierungen und UX-Verbesserungen.

  • Du übernimmst vollständige Verantwortung für deine eigenen Themenbereiche und trägst aktiv zu Produktentscheidungen bei.



Dein Profil 

  • Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium.

  • Du bringst mindestens 3 bis 5 Jahre praktische Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder Software-Engineering mit, idealerweise im Fintech- oder Start-up-Umfeld.

  • Du bringst Kenntnisse oder Erfahrung im deutschen Vermögensverwaltungssystem mit, idealerweise im Umfeld unabhängiger Finanzberater:innen oder Vermögensverwalter.

  • Du kennst dich sehr gut mit agilen Methoden wie Scrum sowie dem gesamten Software-Entwicklungszyklus aus.

  • Du hast einen sicheren Umgang mit Tools wie Jira, Claude for Design, Framer, Grafana, Brevo oder Figma.

  • Du arbeitest sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team und triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher und transparent innerhalb deines Teams, unternehmensweit (auch mit CTO und CEO) sowie mit externen Stakeholdern und Berater:innen.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch (mindestens C1), da der laufende Austausch mit deutschen Vermögensberater:innen ein zentraler Teil deiner Rolle ist, sowie fließend Englisch.

  • Du lebst im Rhein-Main-Gebiet und kannst mindestens 60 % deiner Arbeitszeit in unserem Büro in Frankfurt am Main verbringen.

Warum Ginmon?

  • Hohes Maß an Autonomie und die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Management-Team aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Ein dynamisches, internationales Team mit flachen Hierarchien, schnellen Entscheidungswegen und einer "Get-things-done"-Mentalität.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit einem attraktiven, erfolgsorientierten Bonussystem, gekoppelt an deine Partnership-Meilensteine.

  • Beteiligung am langfristigen Erfolg von Ginmon durch ein Virtual Employee Share Option Program (VESOP).

  • Spezielle Konditionen für Mitarbeiterinvestments und Nutzung unserer Plattform;

  • Hybrides Arbeiten (60 % vor Ort) und flexible Arbeitszeiten.

  • Modernes Büro im Herzen Frankfurts mit High-End-Equipment und optimaler ÖPNV-Anbindung.

  • Regelmäßige Teamevents und eine angenehme Büroatmosphäre (Snacks, Getränke, Firmen-Merch u. v. m.).

  • Erstattung deiner Internetkosten und der Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket.

  • Vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

jobs.description:
Product Owner Marktplace (m/w/d)

Our client in the Aalen area — a leading high-tech company—offers this unique opportunity via temporary employment with the option of a permanent position.

Your future area of ​​responsibility

  • Analyze status quo, evaluate business requirements and develop a strategy for the further enabling international roll-out of the marketplace, align it with global stakeholders from different Headquarter departments and countries, derive and imple-ment the roadmap for executing this strategy

  • Steer the marketplace development team in close alignment with the Head of Marketplace as well as the technical product owner or solution architect including the creation of IT Demands and steering them until their business impact in delivered Ensuring the marketplace fulfills all legal, data privacy, brand and security requirements including the generation of necessary output like approved security concepts

  • Stay aligned with head of marketplace regarding feature priorities, product strategy and technology roadmap. 

  • Ensure the marketplace has an intuitive user interface based on latest trends in e-Commerce, UX and frontend technologies aiming to be best in class for the eyewear industry.

  • Responsibility includes leading the requirement definition and prioritization of entire journeys, new features and feature sets, that improve user experience and drive convesion within the given time frame

  • Work closely/collaborate with cross functional teams including marketing, UI/UX designers, technical product owners and ar-chitects to ensure quality of the solution

  • Coordinate with external Stakeholders the Integration of third-party applications and plug-ins as well as external or internal services

    Drive best in class performance and identify and resolve performance bottlenecks to improve application efficiency

  • Serve as the primary contact for matters concerning Marketplace.

  • Good understanding of agile and waterfall frameworks (hybrid preferable)

Your Profile 

  • 4 or more years of work experience in software product development with of complex products with a proven track record of success-fully launched and operated products.

  • Preferable in a consumer facing, ecommerce environment

  • Willingness to take over responsibility and make decisions 

  • Up to date knowledge in eCommerce experiences. Experience with e-comm platforms like Commercetools, Magento, Intershop as a plus,

  • Able to understand and drive high level technical topics like data management, information security, e-commerce systems integra-tions, marketing strategies

  • Drive to upskill themselves and the team permanently including learning from the best via benchmarking, customer visits and trend analysis in eCommerce outside of the eyecare field

  • Understanding of SEO-principles

  • Agile methods like Scrum, SAFe, Shape-up, etc.

  • Good communication and collaboration in cross cultural and remote teams

  • High level of flexibility and ability to adapt to dynamic and changing environments.

  • English proficiency, German is a plus

  • For international applicants: Please note that the business language is English. C1 level is mandatory and must have for this position

Your Professional Future

Compensation: Pay above the collective agreement rate plus industry-specific supplements

Work-Life Balance: Balancing work and family life is a top priority for us; 30 days of vacation and a flextime account come as standard

Career with Top Companies: Look forward to long-term assignments at renowned regional companies with a genuine option for permanent hire!

Employee Benefits: Benefit from extras such as Christmas and holiday bonuses, subsidized company pension benefits (VWL)

Growing Company: Driven by strong order intake and dynamic momentum

Your dedicated contact person is always available to assist you and handle any concerns

Location: Aalen

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager:in AI & Operations (m/w/d) in einem KI-Start-up
jobs.description:
Bei GrowInTheRole bieten wir einen digitalen Lernraum, in dem Führungskräfte herausfordernde Mitarbeitendengespräche mit KI-Charakteren in einem geschützten Rahmen simulieren, differenziertes Feedback erhalten und durch passgenaue Lernimpulse ihre Kommunikations- und Führungskompetenzen weiterentwickeln. Dafür kombinieren wir psychologisches und didaktisches Know-how mit moderner KI-Technologie zu einer interaktiven, praxisnahen und ortsunabhängigen Lernerfahrung. Als Ausgründung der FEEDBACKPEOPLE Managementberatung sind wir erfolgreich am Markt gestartet. Unser Ziel: GrowInTheRole zum international marktführenden Player im Bereich AI-powered Leadership Development machen. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die mit ihrem Know-how und Einsatz diese Vision mit uns Wirklichkeit werden lassen.

DEUTSCHLANDWEIT (REMOTE MÖGLICH) | AB SOFORT | EINSTIEGSGEHALT: 50.000 - 60.000€ JAHRESGEHALT (BEI 40 STUNDEN/WOCHE)

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest den technischen Betrieb unserer KI-gestützten Lernplattform – von der Qualität neuer Features bis zur Infrastruktur dahinter. Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt, Technologie und den KI-Diensten, auf denen GrowInTheRole basiert, und entwickelst unsere Produktstrategie aktiv mit.

  • Produktentwicklung & Priorisierung: Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserem Psychologie-Team, das die Inhalte verantwortet, und der Backend- und Frontend-Entwicklung. Du übersetzt zwischen den dreien: Dazu bringst du inhaltliche Anforderungen in die technische Umsetzung mit ein, gibst Entwicklungsstände zurück und sorgst dafür, dass alle vom Gleichen sprechen. Du lieferst mit deinen Erkenntnissen aus Testing, Support und Technology Scouting den Input für unsere Produkt-Roadmap und priorisierst, was als Nächstes umgesetzt wird. Neue Features testest du systematisch, deckst Probleme früh auf und entscheidest, wann ein Feature live gehen kann.
  • Qualitätssicherung & Testing: Du baust unsere QA-Prozesse auf und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter. Wenn Fehler auftreten, testest du Frontend und Backend strukturiert durch und verifizierst nach dem Fixing, dass alles wie erwartet funktioniert. Unser Ticketsystem nutzt du dabei für Klarheit und Nachverfolgbarkeit. So sorgst du dafür, dass unsere User eine stabile, verlässliche Lernerfahrung bekommen.
  • Google Cloud, Infrastruktur & KI-Dienste: Du administrierst unsere Google-Cloud-Umgebung und die Zugänge zu unseren KI-Drittanbietern: Projekte, Berechtigungen, Kontingente, Kosten. Du konfigurierst und integrierst neue Plattformen und KI-Dienste zusammen mit dem Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Infrastruktur sicher, sauber dokumentiert und skalierbar bleibt.
  • Technischer Support & User Research: Du beantwortest Anfragen unserer User und hilfst bei technischen Problemen schnell und zugewandt weiter. Anfragen, Feedback und Nutzungsdaten wertest du systematisch aus: So spürst du Bugs auf und leitest daraus ab, wo unsere Lernerfahrung noch besser werden kann.
  • Technology Scouting: Du beobachtest den Markt rund um LLMs, Text-to-Speech, Speech-to-Text und Video-Avatare, bewertest neue Modelle und Tools pragmatisch und bringst fundierte Empfehlungen ein. Deine Einschätzungen prägen, wie sich unser KI-Stack weiterentwickelt.

Qualifikation

  • Sorgfalt & strukturiertes Arbeiten: Beim Testen zählt Genauigkeit. Du arbeitest systematisch, dokumentierst nachvollziehbar und hast ein Auge für Details, die anderen entgehen.
  • Technologieaffinität & technisches Verständnis: Du interessierst dich für Generative KI und hast Lust, dich technisch tief in unser Produkt und die dahinterliegenden Plattformen einzuarbeiten. Entscheidend sind technische Affinität, Neugier und deine Bereitschaft, dich schnell in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen den Perspektiven von Psychologie-Team, Entwicklung und User und moderierst zwischen ihnen, auch wenn Interessen auseinandergehen. Du erklärst Technisches verständlich, gibst Feedback klar und konstruktiv und dokumentierst so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.
  • Startup-Mindset & Eigenverantwortung: Du hast Lust, in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld mit Flexibilität, Tempo und Gestaltungsspielraum zu arbeiten. Du handelst eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert. Fehlende Prozesse stressen dich nicht, sondern motivieren dich, selbst Strukturen zu bauen.
  • Hintergrund: Du hast einen technischen Background und ein abgeschlossenes Studium. Idealerweise hast du erste Berufserfahrung in Bereichen wie technischem Produktmanagement, IT-Administration, Cloud oder QA/Testing. Daher bringst du Erfahrung in der Administration von Cloud-Umgebungen (idealerweise Google Cloud) und dem Verwalten von Zugängen, Berechtigungen und Projekten mit. Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung ist sehr gern gesehen.

Benefits

  • Innovative KI-Anwendung mit Impact: Wir machen Führungskräfteentwicklung skalierbar und wirksam – mit einem innovativen Lernprodukt, das Führungskräften hilft, besser zu führen, und damit Mitarbeitenden und ganzen Organisationen Wachstum ermöglicht. Technologisch wie inhaltlich gehen wir neue Wege und wollen GrowInTheRole gemeinsam mit dir an die Spitze des Marktes für AI-powered Leadership Development bringen.
  • Ein starkes Team und schnelles Vorankommen: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten High Performance Teams, das mit Begeisterung ein ambitioniertes Ziel verfolgt. Wir arbeiten auf Augenhöhe – mit schnellen Abstimmungen, gelebter Transparenz und einem herzlichen Miteinander.
  • Eine Rolle, die mit dir wächst: Du steigst in einer frühen Phase ein und kannst nicht nur das Produkt, sondern auch Arbeitsweisen und Prozesse in unserem kleinen Team aktiv mitgestalten. Wir setzen auf Eigenverantwortung und unternehmerisches Denken – und besprechen regelmäßig, wie sich deine Verantwortung entwickelt und wie sich das im Gehalt abbildet.
  • Arbeiten, wo du am produktivsten bist: Unsere Büros in Greven (bei Münster), Köln und München stehen dir offen – du kannst aber auch komplett remote arbeiten. In regelmäßigen Sprints treffen wir uns persönlich in Präsenz. Wenn du nicht an einem unserer Standorte sitzt, solltest du allerdings wissen, dass Homeoffice wirklich das Richtige für dich ist: Wir setzen dann Erfahrung im remote Arbeiten und eine ausgeprägte Selbstorganisation voraus.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

jobs.title: Client Delivery Lead (Fintech/Payments experience preferred) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

We have been licensing Kraken for over 4 years now, transforming businesses by not only moving their customer base to our Kraken platform but also changing their operating model & ways of working. Throughout this time our team has been at the forefront of industry leading migrations whilst setting a new standard for what business transformation can look like. 

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

You will be joining the client delivery team with Kraken working to support European clients through their technology transformation journeys, supporting long term migration projects.

The Client Delivery Lead has direct responsibility managing a tech domain (billing, finance, comms..) for our client projects. This is either migrating onto our Kraken platform or managing long term technology requirements. They need to work in partnership with the technology and operational teams at Kraken as well as the client to deliver results for our client’s project or business needs. 

 

The Client Delivery Lead has to really understand how Kraken works, understand problems or requests raised by the client and refine solutions in the best way to leverage existing and new capability. They will bring technology, people and processes together to innovate improvements for our clients. You will also support the client in adapting to ways of working that are aligned to Kraken’s development style. You will work closely with Kraken’s product managers and developers to request development needs and act as a link to the client.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • You will be managing the relationship with client counterparts (often product owners and business owners)

  • You will be the first point of contact for tech development and the escalation and resolution point with customers for specific domain/product issues

  • Being the knowledge base of how Kraken works and how we deliver Kraken Platform

  • Triaging incoming requests and communicating client priorities internally. 

  • Summarising and articulating client needs, considerations, timelines internally to enable the ongoing development of the Kraken platform.

  • Supporting the engineering team to deliver product features

  • Challenging the client to think differently about tech development, having full belief in the continuous iteration and deployment approach we have.

 

This is a hands-on, individual contributor position. The role is European based and your projects could be run from any country, travel is expected as part of this role.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for open minded individuals who are comfortable with ambiguity and an ever changing environment. To thrive here you must be a self-starter and willing to roll your sleeves up to solve any problem, constantly flexing outside of your typical job role to drive progress for our clients and organisation.

You must be  committed to the Kraken way of delivering tech based on simplicity, client benefit and efficiency while bringing stakeholders through a journey of change. 

 

You must be willing to challenge beliefs, have the ability to see through multiple viewpoints and, if needed, reach beyond your remit to support the client. 

 

We are building a Kraken for everyone, a universal platform where there is greater benefit in sharing development to enable the green energy transition. Pioneers in this space, we are excited about how Kraken can change the lives of our customers and convinced that Kraken is the best answer, not only for efficiency but as a tool to tackle the climate crisis. If you believe this too then Kraken Tech is the right place for you.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • In this position you will be laser focused on satisfying our customer’s needs. We are looking for people with strong problem solving skills and a super positive solutions oriented mindset. If you have a taste for raising up to challenges and a winner mindset, this position is the right fit for you! (“Every problem has a solution, facing new challenges is exciting because that’s what makes us better every day and the bigger the challenge, the bigger the feeling of success”)

  • Strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Agile delivery experience 

  • Experience of product management and customer journeys

  • Solid understanding of technology and associated trends

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Experience of working with significant complex delivery pipelines for clients

  • Patience and initiative - our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding 

  • Time management and a get-stuff-done attitude

  • Consulting experience is a plus 

  • Fluent English + German is a plus

  • Previous experience in payments is nice to have for this position

If this sounds like you then we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments (all genders)
jobs.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travelers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. ABOUT YOU
 

We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Owner to help define, build, and scale the Xsolla Money Account. The Xsolla Money Account is a strategic initiative to build embedded financial services for gamers, creators, and developers. The product spans wallet capabilities, card issuing, payouts, and future financial tools that remove friction from how value moves across the gaming ecosystem. Sitting at the intersection of fintech and gaming, the Money Account enables new business models, creator monetization, and deeper player engagement.

You will own critical parts of the Money Account roadmap and execution, working closely with cross-functional teams and external partners to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable financial products. Success in this role requires strong product judgment, technical fluency, the ability to navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities, and consistent follow-through from concept through launch and iteration. This role is best suited for someone who enjoys staying close to execution and takes pride in seeing complex work through to completion.

This is a high-impact product area operating in a dynamic, evolving environment with meaningful technical, regulatory, and partner complexity. The opportunity is to shape foundational financial infrastructure that will scale globally and directly influence how money flows through the gaming economy.

Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game.

jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

At n8n, we think the future of software lives in the wonderfully weird space between deterministic workflows, AI agents, and human judgment. Not everything should be automated. Not everything should be agentic. The magic is knowing what belongs where.

We’re hiring multiple AI Product Managers across levels to help shape that layer. You might be a Senior Product Manager who has shipped AI products to real users, or an early-career builder with unusually strong product and AI instincts with a track record of making things. Either way, we care about whether you can turn ambitious, occasionally chaotic AI ideas into product experiences that users can trust, understand, and build with.

You’ll own one focused AI workstream. Depending on your level, you may lead it independently or work alongside a senior PM who acts as your primary mentor. In both cases, you’ll be close to users, close to the technology, and close to the future of AI products.

We move quickly, care deeply about craft, and are still early enough that strong product judgment can meaningfully shape the direction of the platform. You’ll be front and center of n8n’s rocketship, collaborating closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Product Marketing, DevRel, Community, Support, and Customer Success.

This is not an ML platform or research role. We’re looking for people who have built with AI deeply: whether through production products, serious prototypes, public projects, agent workflows, evals, or tools real users have touched.

Where you might focus

AI Trust*

Make AI on n8n trustworthy.

This workstream focuses on evals, observability, traces, guardrails, reliability, latency, cost, debugging, and human-in-the-loop patterns. The layer that turns “AI works in demos” into “AI works in production.”

Mission: raise the bar on AI quality across the platform and make AI behavior inspectable.

AI Building / Super Agent*

Make n8n itself an AI-first product.

This workstream focuses on Super Agent, custom memory, Skills, computer and browser use, files, chat-first building, and proactive suggestions. It's the product-as-AI angle where AI builds with the user, not just for the user.

Mission: shift a meaningful share of n8n usage to AI-native surfaces.

🚀 If this sounds like the kind of ambiguity you like turning into product, hit apply.

*A quick note, because this is AI and the plot moves fast: the workstreams below reflect where we’re headed today. By the time you join, some details may have evolved. Think of them as a useful snapshot of the problems we care about, not a legally binding prophecy.

Requirements

We’re open to different experience levels, but the bar on AI depth, product taste, and builder energy is high.

Must-haves

  • 🤖 AI-native by default: you use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, n8n, or similar regularly, and you follow the AI product space closely.

  • 🧱 Product Management track record: You have successfully shipped real AI products, serious prototypes, public projects, agent workflows, eval suites, or tools used by real people.

  • 🧪 Eval practice: You’ve built or meaningfully shaped evals, not just talked about them.

  • 🛠️ Harness literacy: You understand tool loops, planners, scaffolding, context management, and the practical constraints of agentic systems.

  • 🎯 Strong product instincts: You think clearly about trade-offs, user value, product quality, and what should or should not be built.

  • 🎨 UX taste: You know what good looks like and what beautiful UX feels like. You can explain why one product feels great and another feels off.

  • 🧭 Comfort with ambiguity: You bring order to chaos, structure fuzzy problems, and make progress when there are dozens of possible directions.

For more senior candidates, we’ll also look for

  • 🚀 Shipped AI in production: Real LLM or agent features, real users, real failures you learned from.

  • 🎯 0-to-1 product ownership: You’ve owned ambiguous product areas from problem discovery through launch and iteration.

  • 📊 Data fluency: SQL, funnels, product metrics, and healthy skepticism of what metrics do and do not tell you.

  • 🤝 Influence without authority: You can align engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams around complex product decisions.


For earlier-career candidates, we’ll especially value

  • ⚡ High slope: you learn fast, ship fast, and raise the quality bar quickly.

  • 🪶 Low PM baggage: you’re not overly attached to how PM “should” be done.

  • 🔬 Deep AI tinkering: you’ve built or seriously experimented with non-trivial AI projects, even if they were solo or side projects.

  • 👀 Visible building: public demos, writing, talks, open-source work, or other proof that you learn by making.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🔌 Workflow automation, orchestration, or developer tooling background.

  • 🌐 Open-source and community experience.

  • 🌱 Founding or early-stage background.

  • 💻 Coding background.

  • 📈 Growth experimentation experience.

  • ✍️ Public writing, talks, or visible building.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

jobs.description:
Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) – ADAM Audio GmbH

Location: Berlin office / hybrid (Berlin preferred)

Term: Full-time, permanent

Salary: Depending on experience

Start date: as soon as possible

Travel: Up to 20% (trade shows, studio visits, JDM/ODM partners)

  • Are you passionate about professional studio monitors and the craft of making music?
  • Do you have a strong track record in hardware product management?
  • Do you enjoy working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to bring exciting and technically challenging new product ideas to life?

We are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Product Manager to own one or more of our active studio monitor lines end-to-end - from customer insight and business case, through requirements definition and stage-gate development, to launch and life in the market.

Reporting to the Head of Product, you will be the cross-functional centre of your line(s) and make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing that get exceptional monitors into the hands of the creatives, engineers, producers and mixers who trust ADAM Audio.

Role and responsibilities:

  • You will own the full lifecycle of one or more assigned studio monitor lines through opportunity framing, pre-development, stage-gate delivery, release and post-launch.
  • You will monitor, document and analyse customer needs, production workflows, competitor moves and channel dynamics through structured desk research, user interviews, studio visits, dealer feedback, industry research and product testing - turning that into a defensible point of view for the roadmap.
  • Working in close collaboration with the sales regions during the entire PM process, you will build structured proposals and business cases for new products, refreshes and running changes - including ASP, target BOM, gross margin, volume scenarios and pricing recommendation - for evaluation by Product Leadership and the Exec Team.
  • You will translate opportunities into concise PRDs with clear acceptance criteria, balancing user value against technical feasibility across acoustics, electronics, firmware, software, and mechanics.
  • You will partner with R&D, Project Management, JDM/ODM partners, Operations and Marketing, to make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing to meet market windows and business objectives.
  • You will act as the internal hub across ADAM Audio, ensuring coordination and information flow across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Support throughout development and commercialisation.
  • You will support go-to-market with pricing strategy, competitive positioning, messaging and go-to-market artefacts (data-sheets, user guides, documentation); track post-launch performance and adjust strategy accordingly.
  • You will monitor in-market response and quality (warranty rates, returns, support tickets, dealer feedback) and prioritise maintenance releases, firmware updates and running changes based on business and user impact.
  • You will represent your products at internal and external events - trade conferences, dealer visits, product launches - and act as a credible point of contact for users.
  • Individual and team development is important, and we will support you as you look for ways to grow and improve your personal knowledge and skills. We will also be looking for you to own and help improve our approach to engineering and design knowledge, including best practices, processes, and tools. There will be the opportunity to share knowledge and practices with all companies across the Focusrite group.

Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of Hardware Product Management experience in professional audio or consumer electronics.
  • A working command of the loudspeaker stack to be a credible peer to R&D; you can specify a frequency plot and ask the right questions on the measurements.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to author a business case, build volume and margin scenarios and reason about unit economics.
  • Confidence in designing and running listening tests, structured user interviews and studio visits, and translating subjective audio judgement and objective measurement into specific, actionable requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken - German language skills are a strong advantage.
  • Comfort in working autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and juggling multiple large projects simultaneously.
  • A genuine passion for music, audio and the creative process, with a feel for what studio professionals actually do with our products.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time (trade shows, studio visits, JDM partners in Asia, Focusrite Group regional visits).

Beneficial Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Music Technology, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
  • Direct experience in studio monitors, live sound, hi-fi loudspeakers or other professional acoustic products.
  • Experience working across regional sales organisations inside a group structure.
  • Familiarity with Asian culture and etiquette (JDM/ODM partner management).

You don’t meet every single requirement?

We’re looking for people who will thrive in our team and contribute to our culture—not just candidates who tick every box. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly match every qualification listed, we’d still love to hear from you. Tell us what you would bring to the role and why you’d be a great addition to the team.

We believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us stronger. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including people with disabilities. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know—we’ll be happy to support you.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About us

ADAM Audio GmbH is a rapidly growing, internationally positioned Focusrite plc company based in Berlin Adlershof.

We are one of the market-leading manufacturers of professional monitoring solutions.  

Our customers include renowned recording studios and well-known music producers all over the world, and our products have also been used to soundtrack numerous Oscar-nominated films in recent years.

Since 2019, ADAM Audio has been part of Focusrite plc which houses other, highly respected pro audio brands like Martin Audio, Optimal Audio, Sequential, Focusrite, Focusrite Pro, Novation and Ampify. Our international team at the Berlin-based HQ and the office in China live our passion for music. We constantly drive ourselves to bring fresh ideas and new technologies to our high-quality products to meet the needs of pro audio enthusiasts and recording professionals alike.

We pride ourselves in providing some of the tools that empower creatives all over the world to bring their visions to life. Covering a wide range of products for different levels and budgets, we engage with artists, producers and engineers to become a companion throughout the various stages of their journey.

Our whole business is structured to let everyone contribute and be heard at all levels, and we make sure it’s a great place to work. As a team, we work hard and support each other to master our individual tasks, building and developing the skills of talented and passionate people – to achieve a common goal. So, if you think you can bring something new to the mix, we look forward to hearing from you.

ADAM Audio is an equal opportunity employer. Our employees span a wide range of diverse backgrounds, and we believe that embracing diversity is one of the keys to our future success.

If you want to learn more about the ADAM Audio brand, please go to www.adam-audio.com

We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning.

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz!

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the experience our customers live in every day. Right now, using our product means juggling different tools for leads, performance tracking, billing, compliance, and support.

This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build from the ground up mandate for a product that will touch every customer we have, in every market we operate.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the customer experience end to end, from lead and pipeline management to performance tracking, billing transparency, compliance, and support, unified into one clear, trustworthy product.

  • Design for a genuinely multi sided user base. Customers, their internal teams, and our own internal teams all need different views of the same truth. You'll figure out how to serve all of them without compromise.

  • Turn customer pain into product decisions. Talk directly to customers across our markets, translate what you hear into a sharp, prioritized roadmap, and ship things that make their day to day genuinely easier.

  • Drive company wide visibility and growth. Give both customers and internal teams a real time, trustworthy picture of how the business is performing, market by market.

  • Use AI as your default tool, not a side project. Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and modern AI prototyping tools are part of your daily workflow for discovery, prototyping, PRD creation, and execution.

  • Move fast, end to end. Take ideas from research and discovery through validation, launch, and iteration, using AI assisted workflows to compress the cycle from "we think" to "we know."

  • Champion the initiative internally. Build the case, rally the stakeholders, and be the person who makes this initiative impossible to ignore.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in product management, ideally with exposure to B2B partner ecosystems or enterprise SaaS.

  • You're energized by complexity, not intimidated by it. Multiple user types, multiple markets, multiple stakeholders, one coherent product.

  • You build influence through clarity and trust, not title. You can walk out of a customer conversation and straight into a prioritized roadmap, without losing the thread.

  • Sharp analytical instincts paired with a genuine builder mindset. You'd rather ship a prototype than write another slide.

  • A collaborative operator who makes the people around them better.

Why You Should Join

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

Your mandate: make the company’s platform the most reliable, predictable, and autonomous operating system in the industry, delivering high-quality, scalable solutions that meet customer needs and drive measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and scale the end-to-end operating system for materials trade, transforming fragmented workflows into automated, AI-driven processes.

Deliver Business Impact

  • Reduce operational overhead by replacing manual processes with intelligent, autonomous system behavior.

  • Model the company’s office-only, high-energy culture — fast cycles, clear decisions, and tight collaboration every day.

 

Lead and Scale AI-Driven Product Development

  • Partner with Engineering, AI/ML, and Data teams to design agentic workflows for sales, procurement, and customer operations.

  • Convert human expertise into repeatable, algorithmic playbooks embedded directly into the platform.

  • Drive adoption of predictive pricing, forecasting, routing, and risk models across all core systems.

  • Ensure platform reliability for large-scale transactions, cross-border shipments, and time-critical deliveries.

  • Drive platform expansion across new regions, categories, and fulfillment modes

 

Success Measures

  • A clear and scalable product architecture powering all commercial and operational workflows.

  • Significantly increased automation rates across sourcing, sales, logistics, and finance.

  • A roadmap consistently delivered with precision, speed, and measurable outcomes.

  • A high-performing, metrics-driven product organization, scaled for impact and growth.

  • Recognition of the company as the category-defining AI operating system for industrial supply.

 

Who are you

  • 7+ years of Product leadership experience in B2B platforms, marketplaces, logistics tech, fintech, procurement tech, or enterprise SaaS.

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Deine Position

As Product Manager Procurement & Portfolio Management, you take on one of the most strategically defining product roles within our energy retail business: you design how 1KOMMA5° procures, hedges, and optimizes electricity for an increasingly flexible customer portfolio. You sit at the intersection of energy markets, energy procurement, our flexibility assets, and our customer-facing tariff strategy - and you turn this into a measurable commercial advantage.

  • Own our Procurement Strategy: Define how and where 1KOMMA5° procures energy for our customer portfolio - across day-ahead, intraday, and forward markets. Develop a clear market split logic, and continuously refine it based on portfolio characteristics, customer mix, and market conditions.

  • Design Portfolio Hedging & Risk Management: Build hedging and risk management strategies tailored to different customer portfolios (dynamic vs fixed tariffs or flexibility/ancillary services). Define when and how we lock in volumes, what we leave open, and how we balance commercial upside against risk exposure.

  • Shape Our Flexibility Procurement Model: Design how we procure and steer our flexibility portfolio. Defining models such as flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price-based offers, and the trade-offs between them. Develop the commercial logic and the operational requirements for each model.

  • Run Quantitative Portfolio Analysis: Independently run analyses on procurement performance, hedging effectiveness, and portfolio economics. Build the analytical foundation that supports strategic decisions, identifies optimization opportunities, and quantifies the impact of changes to our procurement and steering setup.

  • Monitor Performance and Drive Continuous Improvement: Define KPIs across procurement cost, hedge effectiveness, portfolio risk, and flexibility margin. Use data to continuously sharpen our market positioning and commercial performance.


Dein Profil

General:

  • 4+ years of experience in (international) energy procurement, portfolio management, or energy trading, ideally in a utility, energy retailer, trading desk, or aggregator environment

  • Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience running portfolio analyses, hedge calculations, and market scenarios (Python, SQL, or comparable tools are a strong plus)

  • Proven ability to translate market and commercial logic into structured processes and product requirements

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving market environment

  • Excellent written and spoken English and German

Market & Domain Expertise:

  • Solid working knowledge of hedging instruments (futures, options, OTC), balancing markets, and BRP settlement

  • Familiarity with flexibility products and procurement models (flexibility bands, fixed volumes, strike-price offers) and their commercial trade-offs

User Research & Discovery

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Full-stack)
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead frontend work in one of our product teams: a TypeScript/Angular application with Storybook-driven components and Cypress e2e coverage, in front of a Java backend. You own the user experience end-to-end, from component architecture and state management down to the API shape, because the backend is yours to touch too. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship without waiting for hand-offs.

Frontend is your craft; full-stack is your reach. You'll spend most of your time in the frontend, and you can ship a backend endpoint when the feature needs it rather than filing a ticket and waiting. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Own complex, data-dense UIs: dashboards, monitoring views, large tables, diffs and drill-downs that stay fast and legible.
  • Drive component architecture, state management, and frontend performance.
  • Build with a component library and Storybook; keep the design system coherent as the product grows.
  • Write tests at every layer. You'll help keep our Cypress e2e suite meaningful.
  • Build the frontend of agentic features: interfaces where users direct, review, and act on LLM-powered workflows.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development on the frontend: conventions, Storybook coverage, and tests that agents can build against reliably.
  • Shape the APIs you consume, and implement backend changes (Java) when your feature needs them.
  • Mentor backend-focused engineers on frontend, helping the team grow more full-stack and deliver features end to end.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building frontend for real products: complex single-page applications with real users, not just marketing sites.
  • Expert TypeScript and deep experience with a modern framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud); strong React/Vue engineers willing to work in Angular are welcome.
  • Frontend craft: component architecture, state management, rendering performance, responsive design, and an eye for detail (you can spot a misaligned pixel).
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Working backend skills: you can read and modify a Java service, design an API from the consumer's perspective, and write competent SQL.
  • Systems insight: you understand how an API's shape drives round-trips, data flow, and perceived latency in the UI.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Data-heavy or developer-tool products: data visualization, monitoring, analytics UIs.
  • Design-system or component-library ownership.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

Compensation: £100,000–£140,000/year depending on experience · Equity / stock options

Location: London, with occasional travel.

 

About Netholabs

Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.

 

The Role

We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.

You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.

 

What you'll do

  • Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

  • Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

  • Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

  • Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

  • Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

  • Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

  • Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

  • Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

  • Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap

     

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture

  • Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

  • Deep understanding of connected-device architecture: OTA update mechanisms, device provisioning, telemetry, fleet management, and what it costs to get these wrong

  • Fluency across electronics, mechanical, and firmware enough to hold a real technical conversation with each - you don't need to design the board, but you need to know when the answer you're getting is wrong

  • Track record of writing specifications and protocols that people actually follow

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a small-company reality: no PMO, no roadmap tooling team, no one to delegate the boring parts to

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

  • Familiarity with human research data collection — protocols, participant handling, IRB/ethics, GDPR and special-category data

  • Experience shipping a product to CE/UKCA or FDA pathway

  • Background in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field

  • Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

What we offer

  • Direct ownership of a product line at a company small enough that your decisions ship

  • Equity in an early-stage company building foundational infrastructure for brain modelling

  • A team of neuroscientists and engineers doing genuinely novel work

  • Central London lab, on-site, with access to the Sussex rodent facility

To apply: send a CV and a short note about a product you took from prototype to manufacture what broke, and what you did about it.

jobs.title: Head of Data Science (12m fixed-term contract)
jobs.description:

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

Data Science at Marshmallow

Our data science team supports various business functions across our Product teams and within Pricing and Claims. Working across the full spectrum of data science problems, from traditional machine learning for risk-based decisioning through to generative AI and the automation of complex operational journeys, all within a regulated insurtech/fintech domain.

It suits a leader who is strong both leading and growing teams as well as a technical decision-maker.

The Data Science team operates as a primary commercial engine for Marshmallow, using data and machine learning to drive tangible business outcomes, from pricing strategy to operational efficiency. The team works closely with senior stakeholders and partners across data, engineering, product and commercial functions to identify the right opportunities and make thoughtful technical trade-offs. We operate with a flat structure, so leaders stay close to the people doing the work and support colleagues at different levels of experience. Our ambition is to keep raising the bar for how data science delivers impact across the business.

Backend and Infrastructure: Latest Java μService, Spring Boot with Spring Cloud, Dynamodb, Terraform, Docker, AWS Fargate, Datadog, Opslevel, and TeamCity.

Frontend and Mobile: TypeScript, CSS-in-JS (Styled Components), React, Redux, Redux Hooks, and other modern state management libraries. Kotlin on Android and Swift on iOS.

Data: SQL, Python, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow & Looker AI at Marshmallow: Sierra.ai for conversational AI, Python and LangChain for agentic AI solutions, Sagemaker and MLflow for Machine Learning, Cursor and Claude Code for developer productivity.

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership: set and hold a consistent bar on technical standards across the full modelling and data lifecycle.

  • Build collective ownership of technical standards across Data Science, coaching people to look beyond their own domain and drive function-wide improvements to shared standards, tooling and best practice.

Who you are

  • You bring an inherently commercial-first mindset: you don’t just build models, you build solutions that directly influence the P&L, and you constantly evaluate every technical trade-off through a rigorous lens of business value.

  • You make confident decisions even when the picture is still forming, and you're comfortable operating across more than one domain at once.

  • You build trust quickly with a team, and coach others to challenge and disagree constructively, to drive decisions that deliver the highest-impact outcomes

  • You thrive in a fast paced and ever-evolving environment; you adapt to change well (and in fact relish it!).

  • You like to take real ownership of your work, drive yourself forward, and work well both autonomously but also collaboratively with the team and your stakeholders.

What we’re looking for from you

Must have:

  • Excellent leadership and team management skills.

  • A strong background as a senior data science individual contributor, with commercial experience delivering ML solutions end to end

  • Proven ability to influence technical direction across Data Science and Engineering, including shaping scalable model/service integration patterns and challenging proposals to drive robust, long-term solutions.

Nice to have:

(We cannot offer visa sponsorship for this role)

A lot of our customers today are enterprise HR and L&D teams, but we haven't given those teams a great way to run what they've bought from us, report on it, and track the value. That gap costs us deals and renewals. We're building our Enterprise customer platform to close that gap. The control center that HR and L&D teams use to manage learners, connect their existing LMS and HR systems, track engagement and CEFR progress, and prove Berlitz's ROI to their own leadership.   • Conduct a lot of customer research. Understand deeply our buyer personas, their jobs to be done, their pain points, and their buying triggers. Talk directly and often with HR directors, L&D managers, and procurement teams to build real empathy for people who touch the product a few times a month, not every day.

  • Design for two distinct users in one product: the L&D Manager who needs fast, frequent, operational tools, and the Global HR Director who needs a clear, summarized view of impact across regions.

  • Build within Berlitz's shared design system while extending it with the patterns a data-heavy, enterprise admin product needs.

  • Help set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Enterprise Products, balancing what buyers ask for against what actually drives retention and expansion.

  • Partner with Engineering and Product Management to ship an MVP fast, then iterate toward a product that can compete with established competitors.

  • Own part of the Enterprise KPIs (dashboard adoption, admin engagement, renewal and expansion metrics) and know how design moves them.

  • Treat compliance and security requirements, including SSO, SCIM provisioning, GDPR, and accessibility standards, as real design constraints from the start, not afterthoughts.

Who you are

  • Advise engineers on testing strategy and testability early, at the design stage, not after the build
  • Push AI-driven QA beyond test generation: bring in autonomous exploratory testing, intelligent orchestration, and self-directed testing workflows

Dein Profil

jobs.title: Senior Technical Procurement Specialist- PCBs/ Electronics (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Senior Technical Procurement Specialist – PCBs / Electronics, you are responsible for the end-to-end procurement of printed circuit boards (PCBs) through our manufacturing partners (Contract Manufacturers, CMs). You work at the interface between Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production, translating technical requirements into clear supplier packages, negotiating costs and lead times, and ensuring that the right boards are available on time and at the required quality level.

This role is ideal for someone who understands how PCBs are actually manufactured (stack-ups, materials, tolerances, DFM) and enjoys the commercial and operational aspects of bringing products to life at scale.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  •  Own PCB procurement end-to-end – from RFQ and quote analysis through PO creation, order tracking, delivery, and closure.

  •   Translate engineering needs into supplier-ready data – review BOMs, Gerbers, stackups, drawings, and specifications to ensure CMs have complete and correct information.

  • Manage contract manufacturers – build strong relationships, align on capabilities and capacity, and drive performance on cost, quality, lead time, and responsiveness, including on-site visits of contract manufacturers

  • Optimize cost and lead time – run competitive RFQs, analyze trade-offs (volume, lead time, technology level), and negotiate pricing and terms with CMs.

  • Mitigate supply and technical risks – monitor material availability (e.g. laminates, copper weights, finishes), propose alternates, and escalate issues before they become schedule slips.

  • Support NPI and engineering changes – coordinate production ramp-up, manage ECO impacts on PCB procurement, and ensure smooth transitions from prototype to volume.

  • Ensure quality and compliance – work closely with QA/engineering to address nonconformances, track supplier performance, and ensure boards meet required standards (e.g. IPC, customer specs).

  • Keep everything organized and visible – maintain accurate data in ERP/MRP and tracking tools, provide clear status updates, and keep stakeholders aligned on dates and risks.


What you bring to the team:

  • Technical background in electronics or PCBs – ability to read schematics, BOMs, and Gerber/ODB++ files; familiarity with PCB stackups, materials, finishes, and manufacturing constraints.

  • Experience in electronics/PCB procurement or supply chain – ideally working directly with PCB fabs and/or PCB assembly contract manufacturers.

  • Comfortable working with engineers – you can discuss layer counts, impedance, controlled tolerances, and DFM/DFT topics and translate that into supplier requirements.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation skills – able to compare quotes, build cost breakdowns, negotiate pricing and MOQs, and structure win–win agreements.

  • Data-driven and detail-oriented – you spot inconsistencies in BOMs/specs, track multiple orders in parallel, and use data (lead times, yields, costs) to drive decisions.

  •   Tool-savvy – experience with Netsuit ERP/MRP systems and common engineering tools (e.g. Altium/KiCad/Cadence exports, Excel/Sheets for analysis, ticketing/project tools for tracking).

  • Collaborative communicator – clear written and verbal communication with suppliers and internal teams; able to summarize complex situations into actionable updates both in English and German.

  • Bias for execution – you’re proactive, take ownership of issues, and push to resolution when schedules and builds are at risk.

  •   Familiarity with PLM and configuration management (ECR/ECO), supplier qualification, FAI (AS9102), and quality documentation.

  •   Clear, concise communication and the ability to lead cross-functional reviews and drive decisions in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.title: Entrepreneur in Residence für work2stay (m/w/d) | B2B SaaS · 100 % remote · bis zur Finanzierung ohne Gehalt · 25 % Beteiligung nach Funding-Milestone
jobs.description:
Wir suchen keinen angestellten Geschäftsführer, der ein fertiges Unternehmen übernimmt.

Wir suchen den Unternehmer, der work2stay aus einer bereits aufgebauten Ausgangslage in ein finanziertes und wachsendes SaaS-Unternehmen führt.

work2stay ist die KI-gestützte Pre-Check Engine für internationale Rekrutierung. Aus CV, Qualifikation und Unterlagen entsteht ein strukturiertes Kandidatenprofil mit Readiness-Report, offenen Nachweisen und den nächsten organisatorischen Schritten – als digitales Quality Gate vor dem Behördenprozess. (Work2Stay)

Das MVP ist live und wird aktuell mit Pilotpartnern getestet. FLYACTS und ein erfahrener Venture Partner haben Problem, Geschäftsmodell, Produkt und erste Marktzugänge aufgebaut.

Dein erster Meilenstein ist klar: Du sicherst die nächste Finanzierungsrunde. Danach übernimmst du work2stay langfristig als Founding CEO und baust insbesondere Marketing, Vertrieb, Organisation und Team auf.

Fachkompetenz im internationalen Recruiting ist hilfreich, aber keine Voraussetzung. Diese Seite kann perspektivisch durch eine fachlich starke Co-Founderin aus unserem Pilotumfeld ergänzt werden.

Deine Stärke liegt im Aufbau einer SaaS-Company:

Kapital gewinnen. Vision erzählen. Kunden überzeugen. Menschen führen.

Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst Finanzierungsstrategie, Investment Story, Pitch Deck und Finanzplan und führst den Prozess von der Investoren-Pipeline über Pitches und Due Diligence bis zum Closing.
  • Du erzählst die Vision von work2stay so, dass Investoren, Kunden, Partner und zukünftige Mitarbeiter Vertrauen fassen und Energie entwickeln.
  • Du gewinnst persönlich die ersten zahlenden Kunden und baust daraus eine wiederholbare Marketing- und Vertriebsstrecke.
  • Du schärfst Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Pricing und Packaging anhand realer Marktreaktionen.
  • Du übernimmst nach der Finanzierung die vollständige CEO-Verantwortung für Strategie, Zahlen, Team und Stakeholder.
  • Du gibst dem Produkt die Richtung aus Kundengesprächen und Verkaufsdaten. Du musst nicht selbst Produktmanager oder Entwickler sein.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast bereits ein Unternehmen gegründet oder ein junges Unternehmen in einer CEO- oder vergleichbaren unternehmerischen Rolle geführt.
  • Du hast als Gründer, CEO oder federführend verantwortliche Person bereits mindestens 1 Mio. Euro externes Eigenkapital eingeworben und den Prozess von Investorensuche und Pitch bis Term Sheet und Closing selbst geführt.
  • Du verstehst B2B SaaS und hast bewiesen, dass du Produkte vermarkten, verkaufen und zu wiederkehrenden Umsätzen entwickeln kannst.
  • Marketing und Vertrieb sind für dich keine Funktionen, die du nur steuerst. Du kannst selbst positionieren, pitchen, Einwände bearbeiten und abschließen.
  • Du kannst eine große Vision erzählen, ohne zu übertreiben. Menschen vertrauen dir, weil du Begeisterung mit Klarheit und Substanz verbindest.
  • Du besitzt hohe Eigenverantwortung, Entscheidungsstärke und Belastbarkeit. Unsicherheit lähmt dich nicht, und Rückschläge verarbeitest du schnell.
  • Du analysierst ausreichend, um gute Entscheidungen zu treffen – aber nicht so lange, bis das Momentum verschwunden ist.
  • Du kannst Menschen führen, Vertrauen schaffen und unterschiedliche Stakeholder für ein gemeinsames Ziel gewinnen.
  • Du identifizierst dich mit der Vision von work2stay und bist bereit, das Unternehmen nach der Finanzierung langfristig und mit voller Verantwortung zu führen.
  • Du kannst die erste Phase bis zur Finanzierung wirtschaftlich selbst tragen.
  • Du kommunizierst sehr sicher auf Deutsch und gut auf Englisch.

Benefits

Die Rahmenbedingungen transparent vorweg

Bis zum erfolgreichen Closing der vereinbarten Finanzierungsrunde erhältst du kein Gehalt und keine Gesellschaftsanteile.

Mit dem Closing erhältst du 25 % Beteiligung an work2stay vor Verwässerung durch die Runde. Der Zeitraum ab deinem Einstieg wird auf das vierjährige Vesting angerechnet.

Wird das Funding-Milestone innerhalb des vereinbarten Zeitraums nicht erreicht, endet die Beteiligungszusage ohne Anteilserwerb.

Nach erfolgreicher Finanzierung ist ein angemessenes CEO-Gehalt Bestandteil des Finanzplans.

Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und beantworte drei Fragen:

  1. Welche Finanzierungsrunden hast du federführend abgeschlossen?
  2. Welches digitale oder SaaS-Geschäftsmodell hast du bereits kommerziell aufgebaut?
  3. Warum sollte work2stay in fünf Jahren ein relevantes Unternehmen sein?

Ergänze bitte ein Video von maximal drei Minuten, in dem du die work2stay-Vision so erzählst, wie du sie einem potenziellen Investor erzählen würdest.

jobs.description:

Du bist technologiebegeistert, neugierig auf die Zukunft des Marketings und möchtest KI sinnvoll in deiner täglichen Arbeit einsetzen? jobs.title: (Senior) Customer Success Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:

Gemeinsam das Rückgrat des europäischen Handwerks aufbauen – mit moderner Software und smarten AI-Lösungen.
Wir entwickeln nicht einfach nur Software – wir haben die Mission, Handwerkerinnen und Handwerksbetrieben mehr Raum zu schaffen, indem wir sie mit einer praxisnahen SaaS-Lösung ausstatten, die so arbeitet wie sie: schnell, effizient und ohne unnötigen Admin-Aufwand. Unterstützt durch smarte AI-Funktionen genau dort, wo sie im Alltag wirklich helfen. Mit Tier 1 Investoren aus Europa und den USA wie Headline und Creandum sowie über 20.000 Handwerkerinnen als Kundenbasis skalieren wir europaweit, um aus einzelnen, verstreuten Betrieben vernetzte und erfolgreiche Communities zu machen.
Wir glauben an zero admin, nicht zero personality – und wir entwickeln jede Funktion mit den Menschen im Blick, die die Sicherheitsschuhe tragen, nicht die Anzüge. Wir haben Bock, die Zukunft zu gestalten, zusammen als Team, und sind bodenständig in unserer Mission, die Macherinnen von morgen zu unterstützen.

DEINE MISSION BEI UNS

Als (Senior) Customer Success Manager (f/m/d) bist du verantwortlich für die ganzheitliche Betreuung deines Kundenportfolios – vom erfolgreichen Onboarding über nachhaltige Produktnutzung bis hin zu Retention, Vertragsverlängerungen und Wachstum. Dabei agierst du als Trusted Advisor für deine Kund:innen und sorgst mit datenbasierten Entscheidungen und kommerziellem Verständnis dafür, dass sie langfristig erfolgreich sind und gemeinsam mit plancraft wachsen.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du identifizierst Upselling- und Cross-Selling-Potenziale, qualifizierst diese und schließt Erweiterungen eigenständig ab.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Support, Product, Revenue Operations, Sales und Marketing zusammen, um die bestmögliche Customer Experience zu schaffen.

  • Du bringst strukturiertes Kundenfeedback in Product- und Go-to-Market-Teams ein.

  • Du entwickelst Playbooks, Dokumentationen und skalierbare Customer-Success-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv den Aufbau einer proaktiven und datengetriebenen Customer-Success-Organisation mit.

DEIN PROFIL

Must-haves

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder einer vergleichbaren kundenorientierten B2B-SaaS-Rolle.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung eines Kundenportfolios über den gesamten Customer Lifecycle.

  • Ausgeprägte Beratungsfähigkeit kombiniert mit Sicherheit in kommerziellen Kundengesprächen.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen sowie datenbasiertem Portfolio-Management, Dashboards und Health Scores.

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und ausgeprägte Priorisierungsfähigkeit.

  • Sehr gute Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills.

  • Du verfolgst einen value-driven Verkaufsansatz und verbindest nachweisbaren Kundenmehrwert mit relevanten Expansion-Potenzialen.

  • Freude daran, in einem dynamischen Umfeld mitzuwirken und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1/C2-Niveau sowie Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B2-Niveau.

Nice-to-haves

  • Erfahrung mit Consultative Selling, Expansion Playbooks oder kommerziellen Verhandlungen.

  • Erfahrung im SMB- oder Mid-Market-SaaS-Umfeld.

  • Kenntnisse in HubSpot, Intercom, Looker oder Customer-Health-Plattformen.

  • Erfahrung im Handwerk, Bauwesen oder verwandten Branchen.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau skalierbarer Customer-Success-Prozesse.

  • Interesse an AI-gestützten Workflows und Automatisierung.

  • Weitere europäische Sprachkenntnisse.

WARUM PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: Mit Leidenschaft, Engagement und echtem Bock setzen wir alles daran, unsere Mission gemeinsam zu verwirklichen. Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

  • Ownership: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung ab Tag eins. In einem Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und hohem Vertrauen kannst du wirklich etwas bewegen.

  • Weiterentwicklung: Wir investieren gezielt in deine Entwicklung – durch eine starke Feedback Kultur, ein persönliches Learning Budget und Enablement Formate. Wir wollen dich bestmöglich unterstützen, damit du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst.

  • AI Enablement: Unsere internen Tools und Workflows sind von Grund auf KI-gestützt konzipiert. Wir unterstützen jedes Team und jede einzelne Person dabei, KI im Arbeitsalltag auf dem nächsten Level einzusetzen – inklusive einer eigenen Claude-Lizenz, selbstverständlich.

  • Tech & Tooling: Du bekommst moderne Hardware wie ein MacBook und hochwertige Over Ear Kopfhörer sowie alle Tools, die du für dein Daily Doing brauchst.

  • Erholung: 30 Urlaubstage, der 24.12. frei, ein Zuschuss zum Urban Sports Club sowie interne Sport Meetups unterstützen dich beim Abschalten.

  • Mobilität: Du kannst dir ein JobRad holen oder ein bezuschusstes Deutschlandticket bzw. eine BahnCard nutzen.
