We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Fraud Intelligence Team

The Fraud Intelligence Team is a small, newly expanding team that defends Marshmallow against fraudulent activity through investigative analysis and industry intelligence. The team goes beyond rules-based fraud checks - we exist to detect new policy fraud trends, investigate networks, and find what automated systems miss. Think ghost broking rings, organised misrepresentation, identity fraud, and patterns that only surface through deep, creative investigation.

Who you are

What you'll bring

Zur Einordnung, damit die Erwartungen von Anfang an stimmen: Das ist eine Sachbearbeitungsstelle mit klarem Rahmen. Was entschieden wird, entscheidet die Personalleitung; was Sie übernehmen, ist abgesprochen. Sie werden eingearbeitet, bevor Sie allein verantworten – Zeitwirtschaft und Entgeltschnittstelle übernehmen Sie schrittweise, nicht am ersten Tag. Saubere, verlässliche Personaladministration ist bei uns kein Hintergrundrauschen, sondern das Fundament, auf dem alles andere aufsetzt.

Noch etwas zur Präsenz: 200 Mitarbeitende brauchen ein Personalteam, das da ist, wenn man es braucht – deshalb arbeiten Sie gerade in der Anfangszeit vor Ort in Buchloe. Nach der Einarbeitung ist Homeoffice perspektivisch nach Absprache möglich. Unsere Arbeitszeit läuft von Montag bis Freitagmittag; wie sich Ihre Stunden darin verteilen, legen wir gemeinsam fest.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Pflege und Administration der Zeitwirtschaft im Tagesgeschäft

  • Vertretung der Teamkolleginnen und -kollegen im Personalteam sowie Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung der HR-Prozesse.

Sachbearbeitung heißt bei uns: Sie denken mit und schlagen vor – wie weit Sie gestalten, entscheiden Sie gemeinsam mit der Personalleitung. Wer lieber erst sicher wird und dann gestaltet, bekommt hier die Zeit dafür.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – genau, schnell, verbindlich

Sie arbeiten gern genau, zügig und verlässlich – und wollen dabei mitdenken statt nur abarbeiten. Sie schätzen klare Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft und übernehmen Aufgaben selbstständig, sobald der Rahmen steht – nachfragen ist hier ausdrücklich erwünscht, nicht ein Zeichen von Unsicherheit. Und Sie springen ein, wenn Kolleginnen oder Kollegen ausfallen – Vertretung gehört für Sie selbstverständlich dazu.

  • Absolute Diskretion und Sorgfalt im Umgang mit Personaldaten sowie solide Grundlagen im Arbeits- und Sozialversicherungsrecht
  • Sicherer Umgang mit HR-Software und MS Office, insbesondere Excel.

Das Spektrum ist breit: Zeitwirtschaft, Recruiting und Personaladministration liegen bei uns in einer Hand, nicht in drei Abteilungen. Ein Teil der Routinen ist etabliert, ein Teil entsteht noch – wir sagen Ihnen im Gespräch offen, welcher Teil welcher ist.

  • Vergütung und Absicherung: unbefristeter Vertrag, verlässliches Fixgehalt, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, JobRad und freier Parkplatz direkt am Standort

  • Pendeln ohne Umzug: Aus Kaufbeuren, Landsberg, Marktoberdorf und Mindelheim sind Sie in 20 bis 30 Minuten hier, aus Augsburg, Memmingen und dem Münchner Westen in gut 40. Bahnhof Buchloe fünf Gehminuten entfernt.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow.

YOUR MISSION AT PLANCRAFT

As a Senior Strategy & Operations Manager (f/m/d), you are a strategic operator, sparring partner, system builder, and connector helping plancraft make better decisions, align around priorities, and turn strategy into coordinated execution.

Working closely with our Strategy & Operations team, Management, and functional leaders, you operate across three core areas: insights & decision groundwork, strategy translation & integrated planning, and execution enablement & company operating systems. You bring structure to complex company-wide topics, connect the right stakeholders and information, and turn ambiguity into pragmatic systems that work in practice.

As plancraft enters its next growth phase on the path to Series C, this role is central to strengthening how we steer and scale the organization. You take end-to-end ownership of critical company systems and selected high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from diagnosing a problem and designing the target setup to stakeholder alignment, implementation, tooling, communication, and continuous improvement.

The role combines two operating modes: running the engine by operating and improving recurring company systems, and upgrading the engine by building the next capabilities and operating models plancraft needs. Your work creates the backbone for greater clarity, alignment, speed, and follow-through across the organization.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as a trusted strategic partner and connector: Build strong relationships across Management and Leadership, connect perspectives across the organization, and help bring the right people, information, and decisions together at the right time.

  • Strengthen company decision-making: Connect relevant internal and external inputs, create transparency, and turn complexity into clear insights and decision groundwork for Management and key stakeholders.

  • Translate strategy into coordinated execution: Design and facilitate the systems that connect company direction with priorities, plans, goals, ownership, dependencies, and follow-through.

  • Build scalable company operating systems: Improve shared processes, communication formats, tooling, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and ways of working that reduce coordination overhead and increase organizational effectiveness.

  • Lead high-impact cross-functional initiatives: Structure ambiguous company-critical problems, orchestrate stakeholders and workstreams, and drive initiatives from diagnosis and design through implementation and adoption.

  • Create clarity and durable impact: Improve visibility into priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, and decision needs, while building pragmatic systems that are adopted by their users and continue to work beyond individual projects.

YOUR PROFILE

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of experience as a strong generalist in strategy, business operations or transformation environments, e.g. as Chief of Staff, Strategy & Operations Manager, in PMO or in a Founders office.

  • Proven ability to structure complex, ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable solutions.

  • Experience designing or improving systems, processes, or operating models in fast-scaling organizations.

  • Track record of leading cross-functional initiatives or programs end-to-end (incl. PMO discipline).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, translating complexity into clear insights and recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills (written & verbal) with experience creating executive-ready materials.

  • Confident stakeholder management skills, especially with senior leadership

  • High ownership, autonomy, and execution strength: you create momentum without needing detailed instructions.

  • Strong judgment to balance strategic ambition and output quality with pragmatic, scalable solutions.

  • Experience working closely with founders or senior leadership in fast-paced environments.

  • Hands-on exposure to areas like planning systems, company operating models and change initiatives.

  • Comfortable using AI tools and building basic workflows and agents.

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

  • Willingness to regularly join the team and key stakeholders in Hamburg for selected workshops and working sessions. For remote setups within Germany, regular Hamburg presence approximately every 4–8 weeks is expected.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Admin level experience in Notion and Slack.

  • Fluent German skills.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

This role is for a strategic operator, systems thinker, builder, and connector who can zoom out to understand the bigger picture and get hands-on to move things forward.

You are someone who:

  • naturally connects the dots across data, business context, and organizational dynamics;

  • turns ambiguity into clear, scalable systems that create meaningful company-wide impact;

  • combines strategic thinking with a high-agency, get-things-done mindset;

  • builds pragmatic solutions that work in practice and can scale beyond the initial problem;

  • is comfortable with high leadership exposure while also doing much of the important work behind the scenes;

  • builds trust quickly, communicates clearly, and challenges constructively when needed;

  • takes ownership of open threads and knows when to align, decide, or escalate.

You are energized by turning complexity into clarity, scalable systems, and forward motion.

WHY PLANCRAFT?

 

  • Team Spirit: We’re driven by passion, commitment, and a shared mission. Team spirit matters to us — and we make it visible: with four major team event weeks per year, casual monthly on-site and remote formats, and a strong recognition culture where we regularly celebrate both the big and small wins together.

  • Ownership: You’re encouraged to take ownership from day one. In a flat hierarchy and high-trust environment, you’re empowered to make meaningful decisions and drive real impact.

  • Learning & Growth: We invest in your personal and professional development through a strong feedback culture with 6-monthly 360° growth reviews, a personal learning budget (1.500€/year), 2 paid days of educational leave, and targeted enablement formats. Our goal is to help you unlock your full potential.

  • Tech & Tooling: You’ll receive a MacBook, premium headphones, and everything else you need — from hardware to tools — to be effective in your daily doing.

  • Flexibility: Whether remote, hybrid, abroad or on-site — you work where you’re at your best. Our Hamburg office (with a rooftop terrace) is always open, and you decide each week how often you come in. And if you need a change of scenery, working abroad worldwide up to 2 months is always an option.

  • Recharge: To ensure the needed rest, we offer 30 vacation days per year (based on a 5-day week) plus Dec 24th off. We also subsidize your Urban Sports Club membership and organize internal sport meetups.

We’re #stoked to shape the future, #together as a team, and #humble in our mission to support the builders of tomorrow. For a first impression of us, take a look at our Instagram and LinkedIn page.

jobs.title: Senior Business Development Manager - Commercial (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Reach for the stars with us. Limehome is building something rare in hospitality: a tech-enabled operator that treats revenue not as a spreadsheet exercise, but as a full-contact commercial sport. As we scale our portfolio toward 12,000+ units, we’re looking for a Senior Business Development Manager to build and drive the commercial engine of a dedicated cluster of properties. This is a builder’s role: you’ll own a real P&L, spin up commercial projects from scratch — new B2B channels, GOPPAR optimization plays, OTA and SEM frameworks — and scale what works. The automated tech stack does the daily heavy lifting; you make the calls and build the playbook the rest of the portfolio will run on.

If you want to run a cluster like it’s your own — with the autonomy to test bold ideas and the data to prove they worked — read on.

How you’ll be hosting with heart:

Build & Scale Commercial Levers

  • Develop new commercial levers from zero to impact: GOPPAR optimization plays, personalized incentives, loyalty mechanics — test them on your cluster, measure hard, and scale what works across the portfolio

  • Build OTA product frameworks: crack where Preferred Partner, sponsored listings, visibility boosters and campaigns actually pay off — and turn it into a repeatable playbook

  • Run Ads experiments via sponsored listings: measure CAC against OTA commissions and steer spend to protect GOPPAR

Drive Local B2B Growth

  • Spin up local B2B as a demand-generation engine: identify, pitch and close the accounts that fill your cluster — corporates, hospitals, universities, contractors, event organizers

  • Build a non-OTA channel of direct stays you can activate whenever demand pacing needs a push; warm leads from the central B2B team are your head start, the pipeline and the results are yours

Own a Commercial Cluster to Test & Validate

  • Own commercial performance (RevPAR, GOPPAR) for a cluster of ~10 Limehome properties — your numbers, your calls and your playing field to solidify your ideas

  • Treat every lever — rate, channel, demand, cost — as something you can pull to move the bottom line

Cross-Functional Influence & Project Development

  • Develop, pilot and roll out new local growth initiatives end-to-end (e.g. personalized incentives, loyalty mechanics, local partnerships) – from idea to execution, without a ready-made playbook

  • Loop in central Channel Managers when your cluster needs a visibility push – OTA ads, content, campaigns

  • Quantify the commercial cost of ops, content or review-score issues and chase the right team to fix them — backed by numbers, not opinions

  • Flag the commercial impact of operational issues (e.g. a maintenance issue hurting your Booking.com score) so Ops can prioritize accordingly


  • 4+ years in business development, commercial or revenue-driving roles: you’ve built and driven commercial initiatives, ideally in hospitality, serviced apartments, short-term rentals or travel-tech — though a strong commercial track record matters more than the sector

  • A builder’s mindset: you love taking an idea — a new sales channel, an SEM test, a pricing play — from zero to a measurable result, and you don’t wait to be told how

  • Commercially numerate: fluent with pricing, pacing and performance data; you measure everything and steer on evidence, not gut feel

  • Comfortable closing: when a project calls for outbound sales, you’ll pick up the phone and pitch — winning new business energizes you

  • Strong cross-functional operator: confident influencing without authority across Operations, Marketing and Distribution

  • Based in Munich or Berlin: this is a hybrid role out of our Munich HQ or Berlin office

  • Business fluency and English, German is a plus

Nice to have (a real plus):

  • Hospitality or travel-tech background: you understand occupancy, channels and how demand really moves

  • Comfort with an RMS / automated pricing: you’ve worked alongside pricing systems rather than doing manual data entry

Why this role is different:

Most business development roles hand you a target and a CRM. This one hands you a P&L and a blank canvas. You won’t just build a pipeline — you’ll build the commercial playbook for your cluster: the B2B channels, the OTA and SEM frameworks, the GOPPAR plays. The automated stack handles the repetitive work; your job is to test bold commercial ideas, prove what works, and watch it scale. It’s a launchpad: this is the pilot for our new Commercial Owner model, so the frameworks you build here become the standard as we scale toward 2029. Build something — and grow with it.

We're designed to stay because:

  • Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office.

  • Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period.

  • Relocation Support: We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office.

  • Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas).

  • Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development.

  • Limitless learning: We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget.

  • Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly.

  • Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering.

  • Everything for our Limehomies: We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉

Who we are:

Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.

jobs.description:
Security & Resilience Lead

📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH)

💰 £50k-£70k (negotiable)

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

This role exists because we're growing fast, working towards ISO certification, and taking on bigger, more regulated customers. All of which means the security practices we handle today need to be documented and independently owned. We're now looking for a Security & Resilience Lead - who'll ensure Street Group's security function operates effectively and continually improves.

You'll work with the Head Of Security to decide what tools, processes and controls should be used, and lead with the ongoing configuration and maintenance of those tools to shape how security is embedded across the business - from development through to customer onboarding and off boarding. There's no team to inherit and no existing playbook to follow: just the opportunity to build one.

Here's what you can expect to be working on as our Security & Resilience Lead

  • Working with technical teams review the security impact of technology changes and ensure security controls are met before production releases.

  • Make sure environments are configured securely, verify controls and oversee technical change so access and data are handled appropriately.

  • Monitor threat intelligence for company exposure, review emerging threats, and share relevant intelligence with stakeholders.

  • Lead the response to security incidents, coordinating investigations and root cause analysis, and producing clear and accurate reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Own our security monitoring capability, ensuring effective logging across key platforms and improving detection while preventing alert storms and false positives.

  • Own the penetration testing and vulnerability management programme - not just detecting vulnerabilities, but risk-assessing them, deciding what needs fixing and working with the tech teams on solutions to close them down.

  • Promote secure development practices, working closely with developers to embed security into how they build rather than simply dictating standards from a distance.

  • Test security alerts, validate backup integrity, and coordinate business continuity and disaster recovery testing to build organisational resilience.

Why you should (and shouldn't) apply

You should apply if:

  • You're just as comfortable running a penetration testing and vulnerability management programme as you are talking to developers or leading an incident response.

  • You have a strong knowledge of logging, monitoring and threat detection, and enjoy tuning and configuring security tooling.

  • You can communicate risk with non technical stakeholders, and communicate confidently with stakeholders at every level.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You don't have hands-on experience with vulnerability management, penetration testing, logging, monitoring or threat detection - these are the two must-have areas for this role.

  • You need close oversight day-to-day; for now, you should be capable of being a security SME in the business alongside the Head Of Security and providing support to technical stakeholders.

  • You want a purely strategic seat with no hands-on delivery - at this stage, it's very much both.

A bit about you

  • A strong track record leading cyber security, ideally built in a scale-up or startup with software experience (SaaS or otherwise) rather than a large, established enterprise - B2B or B2C doesn't matter to us.

  • Hands-on experience owning a vulnerability management and penetration testing programme - not just finding vulnerabilities, but risk-assessing them and deciding how those can be integrated into a technical roadmap.

  • Strong knowledge of performing the continual configuration of existing toolsets as well as assessing potential new tooling and running effective logging, monitoring and threat detection capability.

  • Pragmatic and commercially aware, calm under pressure, highly organised and decisive, collaborative, curious, and focused on continuous improvement - with a high level of integrity.

Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week

🏖 Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)

💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth

📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development

🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away

🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us

👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay

🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured

🧘 Regular well-being initiatives

🕒 Flexible working hours

🚂 Public transport season ticket loans

🌷 Paid menopause leave

🌞 Holiday buying scheme

🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition

👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day

💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology

🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!

🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon

🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours

🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme

£50k-£70k, negotiable depending on your experience and scope. Please apply and let's have the conversation.

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
We’re on a mission to make migration easy.

We started building Marshmallow in 2017. Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones.

To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest.

We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you.

The Marketing Team

Our Marketing team is at the centre of how a fast-growing tech brand shows up in the world. We turn strategy into output that reaches people and performs - across email, social, partnerships, and the website. We're a small, fast-moving team that uses AI as a default, not an afterthought, so we can move faster, automate the manual, and spend our time on the work that actually moves the needle.

As Marketing Executive, you'll work directly with our Senior Marketing Manager and have real visibility across the full marketing operation. You'll own key partner relationships, build and ship campaigns across our owned channels, and keep our performance reporting sharp and current. This is a role for someone who takes ownership, delivers to a high standard, and is accountable for their results.

What you'll be doing

  • Partner, Influencer & Affiliate Coordination: Own the day-to-day management of our Bronze and Silver tier affiliates and influencers - tracking performance weekly, keeping the partner tracker current, and flagging anything that moves. You'll coordinate onboarding, briefing, and deliverables, prepare materials to support contract negotiations, and help spot new partnership opportunities.

  • Owned Channel Execution: Build and deploy email campaigns in Braze - copy, design, segmentation, scheduling, and QA. Own the organic social content calendar, creating educational and entertaining assets for our customers. Build campaign assets in Figma using our brand templates, and support content production for the website and SEO alongside our growth function.

  • Campaign Delivery: Coordinate campaign workstreams and timelines across stakeholders, maintain campaign trackers, QA all outgoing materials before launch, and pull post-campaign data to share reports and learnings with the team.

  • Performance Reporting & AI Tooling: Build and maintain AI-assisted reporting workflows, automating wherever possible across email, social, and affiliate dashboards. Own our weekly performance dashboards and flag underperformance or anomalies before being asked.

Who you are

  • AI-Native: You actively use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or equivalent) to draft copy, automate reporting, speed up research, and cut manual work. You don't wait to be told to use AI - you default to it.

  • A Builder: You ship things on time and to standard, and take pride in the output.

  • Data-Literate: You can pull, clean, and present performance data, and you know what questions to ask of it.

  • Organised: Multiple live workstreams don't faze you.

  • A Clear Communicator: You're not afraid to ask questions or challenge.

  • Commercially Curious: You want to understand your KPIs and where you can impact the business.

  • Brand-Consistent: You care that everything going out to customers meets our standards.

    What we're looking for

  • 1-2 years in a marketing, content, or digital role.

  • Hands-on CRM/email platform experience - ideally Braze.

  • Comfortable pulling and interpreting data from Looker or equivalent.

  • Strong written English.

  • Customer empathy and curiosity - you want to understand our audience and how to speak to them in a way that lands.

Nice to Have

  • Consumer tech or fintech background.

  • Social scheduling tool experience - Sprout, Buffer, Later, or native platforms.

  • Experience in Figma - able to produce campaign-ready assets independently without design support.

  • Experience working with influencers or partners.

  • Affiliate platform familiarity - Optimise or equivalent.

  • Campaign project management experience and tools - Notion or equivalent.

  • Experience writing for SEO or managing web content updates.

How success is measured

  • Execution quality: Campaigns and content land to a high standard, every time.

  • Delivery reliability: Launches happen on schedule. Workstreams stay unblocked.

  • Reporting cadence: Dashboards are current and insights are ready when needed.

  • Partner coordination: Partners feel well-managed. Comms are responsive and clear.

  • Data accuracy: Performance data shared is timely, clean, and trustworthy.

  • Proactive insight: You spot things before being asked and bring solutions, not just problems.

  • AI & tooling: Manual work is reducing. You actively bring new tools and workflows that make the team faster.

Growth

Marshmallow is growing fast, and this role grows with it. Strong performance here - sharp execution, commercial curiosity, and growing strategic instinct - is the path to a Senior Executive or channel lead role.

About Netholabs

Netholabs is a frontier neuroscience and AI research company working at the intersection of deep learning, ethology, and physical engineering. We are on a mission to defend and enhance human agency in the age of superhuman artificial intelligence.

Instead of training AI solely on internet text, we build biological foundation models grounded in evolutionary intelligence. We design custom hardware, ultra-high-density neural recording systems, and complex tracking environments to capture petabyte-scale neurobehavioral datasets. By mapping these biological dynamics to digital organisms, we are building Whole Brain Emulations (WBE) to unlock structurally safe, human-compatible artificial general intelligence.

At Netholabs, you will work alongside world-class neuroscientists, machine learning researchers, and engineers to build the data infrastructure and neural models that will define the future of safe AGI. We have offices in London and San Francisco.

The Role

We're looking for a Human Data Collection Lead to own the quality and integrity of everything we record. We capture people performing real-world tasks, from physical manipulation to computer use, across many precisely synchronised modalities at once: motion tracking, eye tracking, multi-camera video, and neural signals such as EEG.

Right now this is a hands-on technical role. You'll set up and operate the recording rigs, get every device aligned in time and space, and apply the craft that makes neural data clean and trustworthy. Once the data is proven and collection volume grows, the role expands to building and managing the participant pipeline.

Responsibilities

Now: rigs, sessions, and data quality

  • Set up, calibrate, and operate multimodal recording rigs: motion tracking, eye tracking, camera arrays, and neural and physiological sensors

  • Own temporal synchronisation and spatial calibration across every device, so all data streams line up

  • Run recording sessions spanning manipulation tasks and computer use, with neural data recorded throughout

  • Apply neuroimaging best practices: careful sensor placement, signal and impedance checks, artefact and noise reduction

  • Verify each session is complete, correctly logged, and meets quality standards before it reaches the research team

  • Obtain informed consent and handle participant data under UK GDPR; keep clear, versioned SOPs as protocols evolve

As we scale: participants and team

  • Build and manage the participant panel, recruitment, screening, and scheduling; structure repeat sessions and drive retention

  • Help stand up new collection sites internationally and keep protocols, consent, and data handling consistent across them

Requirements

You don't need to tick every box; please lean towards applying if the role seems interesting to you.

  • Background in neuroscience or a related field, with hands-on experience collecting neurophysiological data (EEG or other modalities) and keeping it clean

  • Comfortable setting up, calibrating, and troubleshooting recording hardware

  • Exceptional organisation and attention to detail; systematic, documents everything, lets nothing slip

  • Strong interpersonal skills; participants trust you and colleagues want to work with you

  • Comfortable in a fast-moving, early-stage environment where you define the process

  • Right to work in the UK, and willing and able to travel internationally on occasion

Valued

  • Experience with multimodal or time-synchronised recording setups (motion capture, eye tracking, multi-camera video)

  • Experience running human-subjects research operations (lab manager, clinical research coordinator, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of informed consent, UK research ethics, and UK GDPR

jobs.title: Battery System Engineer/Architect (all genders)
jobs.description:
About Us

STARK is a European defence technology company building the next generation of unmanned systems. We design, develop and manufacture software-defined, mass-scalable and cost-effective platforms that give NATO operators a decisive edge in highly contested environments. We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance capability — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, our work strengthens the technological edge of NATO Allies and their partners.


Your mission

As a Battery System Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, development, and integration of high-performance battery packs for our fleet of drones. Because every gram and watt matters in aviation, you will focus heavily on optimizing for Size, Weight, and Power while ensuring uncompromising safety, thermal stability, and cycle life. You will work cross-functionally with mechanical, firmware, and aerospace engineers to seamlessly integrate the battery system into our application.


Responsibilities

  • System Design & Architecture: Lead the architectural design of bespoke battery packs tailored to the high-discharge and strict weight requirements of UAVs (Unmanned Aerial Vehicles).
  • BMS Integration: Work closely with firmware and electronics teams to define requirements for Battery Management Systems (BMS), including state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health (SOH) algorithms, cell balancing, and fault protection logic.
  • Thermal & Mechanical Management: Collaborate with mechanical engineers to design lightweight enclosures and thermal mitigation strategies that prevent overheating during peak flight loads.
  • Testing & Validation: Develop rigorous test plans for battery packs at the cell, module, and pack levels using testing equipment. Conduct thermal runaway, drop, vibration, and environmental testing.
  • Compliance & Safety: Ensure all battery designs meet relevant international safety and transport standards (e.g., UN 38.3).
  • Manufacturing Support: Partner with supply chain and external contract manufacturers to transition designs from prototype to mass production, ensuring high yield and quality control.


Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in battery system design, preferably in aerospace, automotive (EV), or consumer electronics

Technical Skills:
  • Deep understanding of lithium-based battery chemistries, failure modes, and degradation mechanisms.
  • Experience with BMS architecture, cell monitoring, and protection circuitry.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (e.g.,Catia) and PCB design/review tools (e.g., Altium).
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, I2C, and UART.

  • Hardware Experience: Hands-on experience building prototypes, soldering, and using lab equipment (oscilloscopes, electronic loads, battery cyclers).


Nice to have

  • Direct experience designing battery systems specifically for drones, eVTOLs, or other electric aircraft.
  • Familiarity with writing test scripts using Python or MATLAB for data analysis.

Junior Field Sales Executive (m/f/d) - Munich
jobs.description:
About us:

Saltz is an online food marketplace serving restaurants across multiple European markets. We help chefs and restaurants discover and source products from trusted local and international suppliers.


At Saltz, we believe the best ingredients should be accessible through one seamless marketplace experience. Restaurants purchase directly from Saltz and are fully supported across sales, logistics, customer support, account management, and claims handling. Through our catalogue and platform, we provide visibility into sourcing origins and product information, helping chefs make informed purchasing decisions and discover trusted suppliers worldwide.

We recently closed a €20M Series A backed by leading European venture funds. Our vision is to build the modern infrastructure layer for foodservice commerce - building the new standard for how the world sources food.

About the role:

Own Saltz.App expansion in your city! You’ll find and contact new venues, meet chefs and managers, show how the app works, and support their orders, from cozy lunch spots to Michelin-level places. We’ll train you, and give you room to own your day and your results.

You don't need a sales degree, you need grit, passion for gastronomy, and the drive to grow.

 

What your days will look like:

  • You’ll be out in the field, visiting restaurants and kitchens. Your mission is to introduce chefs and owners to a marketplace that actually makes their lives easier

  • You’ll manage about 10–15 meetings a week and you’ll be responsible for following up and making sure no one is left hanging

  • You will plan your weekly schedule (with guidance when needed) and work towards hitting or exceeding targets

  • You’ll show chefs a demo of our application, in their own environment, how Saltz makes ordering simple and reliable

  • You’ll use our CRM (don't worry, we’ll teach you!) and other tools to keep notes on your progress so the whole team can support you

 

What you need:

  • Whether you’ve run a kitchen, managed a bar, or worked as a concierge, you understand the fast-paced world of gastronomy. Career changers are welcomed! If you’ve done sales internships or part-time customer roles, that’s a huge plus too

  • You’re energized by being out in the field, walking into kitchens, and building face-to-face relationships with chefs and managers

  • Very good oral and written German and English skills

  • You’re comfortable leading a conversation. You know how to listen, solve problems, and confidently seal the deal

  • Bonus: You speak other languages fluently in addition to German or English

 

What you get:

 

  • OTE 52.000€ - 56.000€+ and it is uncapped, so your earnings grow with your performance. Base: 40.000€ - 44.000€

  • 30 days of paid time off - because recharging is part of performing at your best

  • front-row access to the gastronomy world: from new restaurant openings and tastings to pop-up events, you'll be close in the industry you're selling to

  • The hardware you need to get started

  • A company card to cover commuting costs (€200 per month)

  • Autonomy and trust to manage your own workflow

  • Work with and be supported by mature, intelligent, entrepreneurial and fun people who are leading experts in their fields, driven by their passion for the industry

  • A great place to build your first sales career, as you'll learn by doing, hit real milestones, and have people around you who've done it before

     

Interview Process

We aim to keep our process fast, transparent, and focused on getting to know you.

  1. Intro Chat (30 min) – A conversation with our Talent Acquisition Manager to learn more about you, your motivations, and what you're looking for next.

  2. Deep Dive (60 min) – A discussion with our Head of Sales to explore your previous experience, sales approach, and how you think about building and growing revenue.

  3. Offer 🎉 – If everything aligns, we’ll move quickly with an offer and welcome you to the team.

Saltz Marketplace, UAB is an equal opportunity employer. We respect and empower each individual who joins us. Saltz Marketplace, UAB commits to a transparent, inclusive, non-discriminatory recruitment process and employment.

jobs.description:
Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker dgitale Vernetzung (m/w/d) – Fokus Cloud-Native, SaaS & AI

Starte deinen Weg zum Cloud- & KI-Spezialisten bei uns!

Wir entwickeln und betreiben im Managed-Services-Bereich eigene SaaS-Dienste und moderne Cloud-Infrastrukturen. Dabei verändert KI bereits heute, wie wir Software entwickeln, Systeme betreiben und technische Probleme lösen.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine neugierige Persönlichkeit mit schneller Auffassungsgabe, die nicht nur wissen möchte, wie man IT-Systeme benutzt, sondern wie sie tatsächlich funktionieren. Wenn Du gerne tüftelst, Dinge ausprobierst, Systeme auseinandernimmst und Dich in technische Probleme verbeißt, möchten wir Dir mit dieser Ausbildung ein Sprungbrett in die Cloud-Native-Welt bieten.

Während Deiner Ausbildung wirst Du strukturiert an den stabilen Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Native-Umgebung herangeführt. Gleichzeitig lernst Du, KI als Werkzeug für Deine eigene Arbeit einzusetzen und zunehmend auch KI-gestützte und autonome Systeme zu betreiben, zu überwachen und sicher zu kontrollieren.

Aufgaben

Deine Ausbildungsschwerpunkte. Hier wächst Du hinein:

Gemeinsam mit Deinen Ausbildern und Mentoren meisterst Du Schritt für Schritt diese Kernbereiche:

  • Cloud-Infrastruktur: Du lernst den Aufbau, die Automatisierung und den Betrieb unseres modernen Cloud-Native-Stacks kennen.
  • Vom Code zum Live-System: Du begleitest den Weg neuer Software-Releases vom Code bis zum produktiven System, überwachst die Performance und lernst, Systeme stabil zu halten.
  • Automatisierung: Du erfährst, wie man wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben durch Code und Automatisierung effizienter macht – und warum wir Dinge, die Maschinen zuverlässig erledigen können, nicht dauerhaft von Hand machen wollen.
  • KI & autonome Systeme: Du lernst, KI für Entwicklung, Analyse, Troubleshooting und Automatisierung einzusetzen. Mit wachsender Erfahrung beschäftigst Du Dich auch damit, wie KI-Agenten selbstständig Aufgaben übernehmen und wie solche autonomen Systeme sicher betrieben, überwacht und kontrolliert werden.
  • Team-Support: Du unterstützt uns bei der Entwicklung und dem Betrieb neuer Produkte und wirst im Laufe Deiner Ausbildung zum kompetenten Ansprechpartner für Cloud-, Plattform- und Automatisierungsthemen.

Das erwartet Dich. Dein Tech-Stack zum Lernen:

Erste Erfahrungen mit IT sind ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Ob durch eigene Projekte, in der Schule oder während eines Praktikums, wenn Du bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit IT hattest, kannst Du bei uns darauf aufbauen und lernst, wie daraus Praxis wird.

  • Kubernetes: Einblicke in das Design und den Betrieb moderner SaaS-Workloads.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Einstieg in moderne Infrastrukturverwaltung mit Terraform/OpenTofu und Helm.
  • GitOps: Kontinuierliche Bereitstellung von Software mit Argo CD oder Rancher Fleet.
  • CI/CD-Pipelines: Mitarbeit beim Aufbau und bei der Pflege automatisierter Build-, Test- und Deployment-Pipelines.
  • Observability: Verstehen und Nutzen von Logs, Metriken und Alerting zur Systemüberwachung und Fehleranalyse.
  • AI & Agents: KI-gestütztes Arbeiten, Large Language Models, Tool-Calling und autonome Agenten als Bestandteil moderner IT-Systeme.
  • Security & Backups: Grundlagen der Cloud-Sicherheit sowie das Testen von Backup- & Restore-Strategien.
  • Incident-Handling: Lernen, wie man professionell und strukturiert mit Systemstörungen umgeht und sich Schritt für Schritt bis zur eigentlichen Ursache eines Problems vorarbeitet.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Schulische Basis: Du hast die (Fach-)Hochschulreife oder einen Realschulabschluss in der Tasche. Gerne auch Studienabbrecher, die festgestellt haben, dass sie lieber praktisch an echten Systemen arbeiten möchten. Für uns zählt dabei nicht nur Dein Zeugnis, sondern vor allem Dein technisches Interesse und Deine Lernfähigkeit.
  • Erste IT-Berührungspunkte: Du bringst theoretische oder praktische Grundkenntnisse mit – zum Beispiel Linux-Basics, erste Skripte oder Programmiererfahrung, Docker, Netzwerke, Hardware oder andere Erfahrungen aus Freizeit, Praktikum oder Schule.
  • IT-Begeisterung: Du hast keine Angst vor Code-Zeilen, tüftelst gerne am PC und bleibst hartnäckig dran, bis Du verstanden hast, warum etwas funktioniert – oder warum eben nicht.
  • Technische Neugier: Vielleicht hast Du schon einmal einen eigenen Server aufgesetzt, ein Homelab gebaut, Linux installiert, mit Docker oder virtuellen Maschinen experimentiert, Hardware zusammengeschraubt, einen Raspberry Pi zweckentfremdet, ein kleines Tool geschrieben oder ein System einfach aus Neugier auseinandergenommen.
    **Solche Dinge interessieren uns. Erzähle uns davon.**
  • KI als Werkzeug: Du möchtest KI nicht nur benutzen, um Dir fertige Antworten geben zu lassen. Du willst verstehen, wie Du sie als Werkzeug einsetzen kannst, um schneller zu entwickeln, Probleme zu analysieren und neue Dinge zu bauen. Wir suchen Menschen, die mit KI mehr bauen können als ohne sie.
  • Lernbereitschaft: Du hast Lust, Fehler als Lernchancen zu sehen, selbstständig nach Ursachen zu suchen und Dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Uns ist dabei wichtiger, wie Du denkst, lernst und technische Probleme angehst, als wie gut Du Dich verkaufen kannst.

Denn die IT, für die wir Dich ausbilden, verändert sich gerade grundlegend, denn KI wird unsere Arbeit zunehmend unterstützen und dabei immer mehr Aufgaben selbstständig übernehmen. Dadurch verschwinden technische Herausforderungen nicht, sondern sie verschieben sich.

Wir wollen Dich darauf vorbereiten, die Cloud-Plattformen, Automatisierungen und autonomen Systeme von morgen zu verstehen, zu bauen, zu betreiben und unter Kontrolle zu halten

Benefits

Das bieten wir Dir für Deinen Start:

  • Strukturierte Ausbildung: Ein festes Mentoring-Modell, bei dem Dir ein erfahrener Ausbilder im Arbeitsalltag zur Seite steht.
  • Hohe Übernahmechancen: Wir bilden für den eigenen Bedarf aus und möchten Dich nach erfolgreichem Abschluss gerne fest übernehmen.
  • Gezielte Weiterentwicklung: Wir unterstützen Dich bei Prüfungsvorbereitungen und nützlichen Cloud-Zertifizierungen (z. B. CKA/CKAD).
  • Moderne Arbeitsweise: KI gehört für uns zum Werkzeugkasten moderner IT. Du lernst, sie sinnvoll einzusetzen, ihre Ergebnisse kritisch zu hinterfragen und mit ihrer Hilfe Dinge zu bauen und zu automatisieren, die vorher deutlich mehr manuellen Aufwand benötigt hätten.
  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, direkter technischer Austausch auf Augenhöhe und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Flexibilität: Planbare Flexibilität in Deinen Arbeitszeiten und moderne Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten nach der Einarbeitung.

  • Develop self-service and reliability tooling that reduces manual operational work and empowers end users and internal teams.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders (security, IT, engineering, finance) to design access policies, implement compliance controls, and integrate device trust with identity frameworks.

  • Mentor team members, set technical direction, and help define the charter and short- and long-term roadmaps of the Corporate Infrastructure team.

Qualifications

  • Experience architecting and operating large-scale identity and endpoint management solutions across macOS, Windows, and mobile platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of IT automation, infrastructure-as-code, and building tooling to streamline onboarding, provisioning, and compliance at scale.

  • Demonstrated record of working with stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
Head of Revenue Operations

Deine Mission

Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln.

trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen.

Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen.

Über trawa

trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen.

Wir suchen eine:n Head of Revenue Operations, um gemeinsam die nächste Wachstumsstufe zu erreichen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren General Manager Energy Solutions und arbeitest eng mit unseren Commercial-Teams zusammen. Du gestaltest das Produkt mit, das die europäische Industrie wieder wettbewerbsfähiger macht – und setzt deine Ideen mit hohem Tempo um.

Die Position ist in Berlin angesiedelt. trawa ist ein Office-First-Unternehmen: In der Regel arbeitest du an fünf Tagen pro Woche aus unserem Büro.

Das Team

Unser Revenue Operations Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Nach einer Phase starken Wachstums gilt es nun, das Team gezielt für die nächste Wachstumsphase aufzustellen – sowohl für die weitere Skalierung in unserem Heimatmarkt Deutschland als auch für die Expansion in weitere Märkte.

Wen wir suchen

  • Revenue Engine: Du übernimmst die weltweite Verantwortung für den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Revenue Operations Aktivitäten, durch die aus Leads verlässlich planbarer Umsatz entsteht

  • CRM: Du definierst die CRM-Architektur inkl. Datenmodell und Funnel Design, stellst systematisch die Datenqualität sicher, verantwortest Prozessdefinition und Governance sowie die Prozessautomatisierung

  • Tooling: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis der Sales Journey unserer Kunden und entwickelst sowohl customer-facing sowie internes Tooling, um die Effizienz und Conversion Rates unserer Revenue-Organisation strukturell zu steigern

  • Reporting & Analytics: Du ermöglichst ein zielgerichtetes Steering unserer Account Executive und Sales Development Teams durch Reporting & Dashboarding und deckst durch Analysen Optimierungspotenziale im Rahmen von Strategiediskussionen auf

  • CPQ: Du übernimmst die ganzheitliche Verantwortung für Angebotserstellung, Contracting und Commissioning, in dem du unsere Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen stetig weiterentwickelst und dabei auch eng mit unserem Tech Team zusammenarbeitest

Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du hast das notwendige Verständnis zu unseren Produkten, zum Energiemarkt, zur Sales Journey unserer Kunden sowie zu relevanten internen Prozessen aufgebaut

  • Du hast dich als fester Ansprechpartner des Revenue Operations Teams etabliert - und bist im stetigen Austausch mit allen wichtigen internen und externen Stakeholdern

  • Du hast eine Strategie für Revenue Operations bei trawa entwickelt, klare Prioritäten gesetzt und eine Roadmap mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten und Meilensteinen aufgesetzt, die unser weiteres Wachstum in Deutschland und die Expansion unterstützt

  • Du hast dabei insbesondere erste Optimierungsprojekte zur Steigerung der Conversion Rates sowie zur internen Prozessoptimierung angestoßen - und erste Ergebnisse sind in Sicht

Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an

  • Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken

  • Du berücksichtigst bei deiner Entscheidungsfindung sowohl strategische Ziele wie kommerzielle Auswirkungen und kannst dich sowohl in die Perspektive von Kunden als auch von unserem Vertrieb hineinversetzen

  • Durch offene und wertschätzende Kommunikation, konstruktives Feedback und klare Prioritäten befähigst du dein Team, gemeinsam erfolgreich zu sein.

  • Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

Warum trawa?

Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt.

Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung.

Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt.

Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können.

Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents.

Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (w/m/d) - B2B Saas I Berlin (hybrid)
jobs.description:
We are digitalising one of Europe’s largest and most heavily regulated industries.

 

The packaging industry has a market volume of several hundred billion euros and is under enormous pressure to act due to new regulations such as PPWR, EPR and EUDR.

 

With Packa, we have built the first end-to-end SaaS platform for intelligent packaging management – in high demand, well-funded and growing fast.


What you can expact at Packa

  • Creative freedom: You work directly with Packa’s leadership team – with real impact from day one.

  • Ownership: You’ll be part of a highly motivated, diverse and successful team with a high degree of freedom and responsibility from the start.

  • Hybrid work: You work from a great office in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg.

  • Leadership: You work in a company with an inspiring vision, led by an experienced founding team and backed by leading investors.

  • Recognition and commitment: We believe in fair compensation and offer a clear growth path with real development opportunities.


Your responsibilities

  • You actively contribute to the technical evolution of our platform and bring in your own ideas on how to make our product more robust, performant, and scalable.

  • You take part in technical design decisions – from the architecture of individual features to cross-cutting topics such as data models, API design, or tooling.

  • You work closely with Product, Design, and Business stakeholders to shape technical solutions around user needs – and you're not afraid to challenge the original requirement when you see a better way.

  • You work in a structured and self-directed manner: from task breakdown through implementation to deployment and monitoring in production. Code reviews, testing, and clean documentation are a given for you.

  • You collaborate closely with Senior Engineers and the Tech Lead and grow technically along the way – through pair programming, joint architecture sessions, and honest, constructive feedback.


What you bring

  • You have up from 5/6 years of experience in software development – ideally in a scaling SaaS environment where you've not only built features but also supported them live in production.

  • You have solid skills in TypeScript and Node.js, ideally with NestJS on the backend – complemented by a good understanding of modern frontend technologies such as React.

  • You've already gained experience in building modern APIs, working with different system architectures, and data modeling – and you can weigh trade-offs between different approaches.

  • You're familiar with deployment, testing, and CI/CD processes and see them as an integral part of development, not an afterthought.

  • You know your strengths, apply them deliberately – and actively ask for support when it makes sense, instead of getting stuck.

  • You work in a solution-oriented, pragmatic way and stay close to the product vision: you ask "why" behind a requirement before jumping to "how".
